CNBC’s updated article says a person familiar with the matter reported Anthropic priced its IPO at eighty-three dollars per share, newer than the feed headline about considering a higher price. It describes expected trading and conditional proceeds using the previously stated share count.

The pricing remains source-attributed here, not checked against a final filing. Expected trading is not completed trading, and projected proceeds depend on shares actually sold; they are distinct from market capitalization or investor profit.
highlights: Article has advanced beyond the earlier feed headline
Pricing is attributed to an unnamed source
Projected proceeds depend on share count
Trading was expected rather than observed
Offering price does not determine investor return
